profile.headline: Software Support and Development
profile.summary: Hello! My name is Kendale Thomas and I'm looking to further my career in the IT Managed Services field. I currently work as a Systems administrator and have additional experience in customer service and helpdesk roles.

positions.title: Information Technology System Administrator
positions.description:
•	Documenting tickets using Kaseya BMS
•	Building and deploying 
•	On call for remote and onsite troubleshooting
•	Configuring and troubleshooting firewalls (Sonicwall)
•	Managing and configuring VPN connections (Sonicwall Netextender)
•	DNS
•	DHCP
•	Configuring Domain Controllers (Active Directory Azure AD)
•	Windows 10 configuration and deployment
•	Microsoft Exchange

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst
positions.description:
•	Troubleshooting customer account issues
•	Using a ticketing system to solve and document customer issues (Oracle, Atlas, Ivanti, Solarwinds)
•	Managing user accounts
•	Providing technical support via phone, chat, and email
•	Managing Outlook account (delegate access, shared inboxes, exchange admin)
•	Trouble shooting VPN issues (Cisco Anyconnect, Forticlient VPN, Windows VPN)
•	Troubleshooting issues via remote software (RDP, Solar Winds Take Control, Connect Wise, GoToAssist)
•	Troubleshooting user phones (Avaya, Maraki)

positions.title: Service Desk Analyst
positions.description:
•	Service desk support for law firms via remote access (Team Viewer, GoToAssist, Bomgar, VMWare, SCCM, RDP, Citrix)
•	Troubleshooting Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Powerpoint, Excel)
•	Troubleshooting user account issues using Windows Server/ Active Directory (security group management, account creation, password resets)
•	Documenting trouble shooting using a ticketing system. (IQ Track, Servicenow)
•	Making and receiving client calls using a SIP phone
•	Troubleshooting VPN connection issues (Cisco Anyconnect, Global Protect)
•	Researching user issues using company knowledge base, past tickets, and google
